CITY OF SAN MARINO

  DESIGN REVIEW COMMITTEE AGENDA

Rick Chou, Chair
Raymond Cheng, Vice Chair  www.sanmarinoca.gov
Christa Lakon, Member  (626) 300­0700 Phone

Steven Jones, Member  2200 Huntington Drive
  San Marino, CA 91108

  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE
  DESIGN REVIEW COMMITTEE
  WEDNESDAY, APRIL 16, 2025 AT 6:00 PM
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Design
Review Committee with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 1st and 3rd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m.

In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires a
reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact
the City at (626) 300­0700 o r a t Planning@SanMarinoCA.gov prior to the meeting for
assistance.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City will
do it’s best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to participate in the meeting from home:
Visit www.SanMarinoCA.gov/Zoom

How to offer public comment from home:
How to offer public comment from home: Public comment will be accepted by email to
Planning@SanMarinoCA.gov until 3:00 p.m. the day of the meeting. Written public comment
received by 3:00 p.m. will be distributed to the Design Review Committee during the meeting.
Any comments received after 3:00 p.m. will be included in the public comment record but not
provided to the Design Review Committee at the meeting. Written public comment will be
accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module during the meeting. Written
Zoom comments will be accepted after the in­person comments.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Alternate Suzanne Torgeson, Alternate Nora Hoyos, Member Steven Jones, Member Ted
Lee, Member Christa Lakon, Vice Chair Raymond Cheng, Chair Rick Chou

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the
Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.SanMarinoCA.gov.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the Design Review
Committee by completing a public comment card and giving it to the Community
Development Director prior to the meeting. At this time, the public may address the Design
Review Committee on items that are not on the agenda. Pursuant to state law, the Design
Review Committee may not discuss or take action on issues not on the meeting agenda
(Government Code Section 54954.3). The Chair reserves the right to place limits on duration
of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

  PUBLIC HEARINGS

1.  CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL FOR DESIGN REVIEW CASE NO. DR
  21­12 AT 2200 LORAIN ROAD FOR THE MODIFICATION OF THE
  FRONT FACADE (LEUNG)
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Design Review Committee:1. Determine that
  based on the whole of the administrative record, that the proposed addition is
  exempt from CEQA pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines, Article 19, Section 15302,
  Class 1, and that there is no substantial evidence demonstrating an exception to the
  categorical exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15300.2 applies. 2. Find
  that the proposed project meets the required findings; and 3. Approve the project.
  Planner: Camillia Martinez, Associate Planner

2.  CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL FOR DESIGN REVIEW CASE NO. DR
  24­66 AT 679 LA MIRADA AVENUE FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OF A
  SIDE AND REAR YARD BLOCK WALL, DRIVEWAY GATE AND TWO
  PEDESTRIAN GATES ADJACENT TO THE STREET (LIN)
  Recommendation: B a s e d o n t h e i n f o r m a t i o n s u b m i t t e d t o t h e r e c o r d , s t a f f
  recommends the Design Review Committee: (1) Determine that the proposed project
  is exempt from CEQA pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines, Section 15301 (Class 1,
  Existing Facilities), and that there is no substantial evidence demonstrating an
  exception to the categorical exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15300.2
  applies; (2) Find that the proposed project meets all the applicable findings; and (3)
  Approve the project with the following condition: (a) The approval is granted for the
  proposed 5’4” pedestrian gates and proposed block wall, and not for the proposed
  driveway gate.
  Planner: Aubrey Stark­Miller, Assistant Planner

3.  CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL FOR DESIGN REVIEW CASE NO. DR

  CERTAINTEED PRESIDENTIAL SHAKE TL IN THE SHADOW GRAY
  COLOR (LEHR)
  Recommendation: B a s e d o n t h e i n f o r m a t i o n s u b m i t t e d t o t h e r e c o r d , s t a f f
  recommends the Design Review Committee: (1) Determine that the proposed project
  is exempt from CEQA pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines, Section 15301 (Class 1,
  Existing Facilities), and that there is no substantial evidence demonstrating an
  exception to the categorical exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15300.2
  applies; (2) Find that the project meets all applicable findings; and (3) Approve the
  project with the added condition that the special installation requirements for
  composition fiberglass shingle roofing material listed on the City’s Pre­Approved
  Roofing Materials, Colors, and Applications List shall be applied.
  Planner: Arielle Truong, Assistant Planner

  Planner: Arielle Truong, Assistant Planner

5.  CONSIDERATION OF DENIAL FOR DESIGN REVIEW CASE NOS. DR

  SQUARE­FOOT, ONE­STORY REAR ADDITION WITH AN ATTACHED
  417 SQUARE­FOOT COVERED PATIO, AND FACADE CHANGES; AND
  THE REMOVAL AND REPLACEMENT OF FIVE (5) HERITAGE TREES
  AND ONE (1) ESTABLISHED TREE (SZURPICKI)
  Recommendation: B a s e d o n t h e i n f o r m a t i o n s u b m i t t e d t o t h e r e c o r d , s t a f f
  recommends the Design Review Committee deny the project.
  Planner: Sevag Sassounian, Associate Planner

  CONSENT CALENDAR

6.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the Design Review Committee approve the
  minutes of the special meeting of March 19, 2025.

DIRECTOR'S REPORT

This is an opportunity for the Community Development Director to inform the Design Review
Committee and the public of any matters of interest.

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the Design Review Committee. All public writings distributed by the
City of San Marino to at least a majority of the Design Review Committee regarding any item
on this agenda will be made available at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200
Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda
packet that will available for review at the Design Review Committee meeting.
